tools.name: pre_consent_scan
tools.description: Free, no sign-in: fetch a public page as a first-time visitor and report which trackers (GA4, Google Ads, Meta Pixel, TikTok, LinkedIn, Hotjar…) and cookies load before the visitor consents, which ones wait, which other sites the page contacts (e.g. Google Fonts), and how to fix it. Static check of

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Show the signed-in PrivacyPill account: number of sites, licenses (Free, Pro, Lifetime) and limits.

tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List the domains (sites) on the PrivacyPill account with their plan, site key and last scan score.

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Get one site with its full cookie banner settings (layout, colours, categories, Consent Mode, languages).

tools.name: create_site
tools.description: Add a domain to PrivacyPill and create its cookie banner. Returns the site, its banner settings and the embed snippet. The free plan includes one site.

tools.name: configure_banner
tools.description: Update a site's cookie banner: layout (pill, bar, modal, corner), colours or preset, categories, services, Google Consent Mode v2, languages and wording. Only the fields you pass change. Pro sites can also switch geo-targeting and monthly rescans.

tools.name: get_embed_snippet
tools.description: Get the one-line PrivacyPill embed (with Consent Mode fallback) for a site, plus install steps for HTML, Google Tag Manager, WordPress, Shopify and Webflow.

tools.name: run_compliance_scan
tools.description: Scan a public web page for trackers (GA4, Google Ads, GTM, Meta Pixel, Hotjar, TikTok, LinkedIn…), cookies and Consent Mode setup, and get a 0–100 compliance score. Scans of your own domains are saved; apply=true adds the detected services to that site's banner.

tools.name: list_banner_presets
tools.description: List the built-in banner colour presets and the allowed layouts, languages and categories.
